source_row.rationale: A significantly low platelet count (such as 25,000/mm³, well below the normal range of approximately 150,000-400,000/mm³) places the client at high risk for spontaneous bleeding. Bleeding precautions include using a soft toothbrush, avoiding intramuscular injections and unnecessary invasive procedures when possible, using an electric razor instead of a blade, avoiding activities with high injury risk, and closely monitoring for any signs of bleeding.
source_row.source_name: Clinical Hematology References — Thrombocytopenia Bleeding Precautions
source_row.stem: A client has a platelet count of 25,000/mm³, and a family member encourages the client to keep up their usual daily jog since staying active seems like the healthy thing to do. The nurse should instead implement which precaution given this significant thrombocytopenia?
